notes.title: Garland Boy release on 6/6
notes.content:
Garland Boy release date is confirmed on release on 6 July 2025! Finally!

Here is a sneak peek of what is added in the full version:

Character customization!
I wish I there is Garland Girl version too!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172953/bea29102b20b86f5b0649bd3175a71e413b85fa1.jpg

New minigames
3 New minigames, plus 3 you already saw in demo, to total of 6.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172953/5861f95596857a5f59889a0d8c10f7756e451deb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172953/369c4dca360692e6772a42d8a08b5d43d4108503.jpg

Developer commentary
After letting my international friends and testers play the game. I see that there might be some cultural difference that some players from different background might not get some concept or cultural facts presented in the game.
So I decided to include a developer commentary section (unlocked after you have beaten the game) and tried my best to explain cultural reference the game used.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172953/aea1e2e1de1d46a9f3ecde8447cbec392412ec52.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172953/1b69f6bc4bc374c4001baab501e5d815f7da242e.jpg

Mobile version
There were lots of voices when our demo released on Oct/2024 that they wished there are also mobile version. So be it! I'm also offering mobile version in parallel. The mobile version will be free to download and play up to week 4 (just like Steam demo version) then it will prompt you to unlock the full game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172953/699265195ac9cc09d2fce8197eba4af8fba93bf5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172953/ceba0036355e13b809e0c81e2ffc2e55c9301837.jpg

More info on mobile version here: https://www.wappen.games/garlandboy-mobile
Note that Android version is not yet ready due to Google Shenanigan and complex submission process.

Also, Garland Boy will also participating in the upcoming Southeast Asian Games Showcase Steam event on 6/6.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172953/09ad59fe7f00a7dc11a2ce6b00faec4631c07084.jpg
There will be premier announcing exclusive reveals, new trailers, and updates from 45+ Southeast Asian games. Plus 300+ games from SEA joining this Steam event.

More info here: https://x.com/SEAGShowcase/status/1924797260090544507

Until then ːsteamhappyː
